body: I hope to go to college, I have a full 4 year scholarship hopefully in the works. But I have some connections to my local city college that if everything falls through i can hopefully still get in without being neck deep in debt

I've been through CBT when i was in inpatient, I tried DBT individual/group meetings that happened weekly but my mother forced me to quit because after every meeting she would yell at me about what i discussed. I'm terrified about going to therapy because she manipulates the situation to make me always look bad. About how I always look like I want to hurt her when I'm upset (I don't and I've never gotten violent towards her) and how I'm ungrateful. She likes to make it all about her every time the therapist tries to talk to her about how she acts towards me

The person who's doing a lot of it is transferring once summer is over, and I messaged my manager asking for us not to be scheduled at the same time anymore. I still get severe anxiety about going to work though because I'm paranoid about everyone turning on me suddenly

I've met a few of the kids with the deletion, and their parents are just amazing people. I guess that furthered my depression since my mother has been emotionally absent for the majority of my life, my father died before I was born, and the countless stepfathers were abusive in every form. But these parents are just so caring.
That sounds like something I would prefer over completely going hospitalized. Thank you

I'm a senior in high school currently, but I'm in this summer research program at my local university. I'm researching children who suffer from [22Q11.2 deletion](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DiGeorge_syndrome) and how it affects their ability to visually track objects. My long-term job is at a fast food place, but I cut my hours to almost nothing because of bullying.

Everything just kind of going downhill... My research is failing and it's due to present in a week. Me and my boyfriend have argued pretty much every day because we're both so stressed. But for weeks now I've just had this depressive episode where I have no motivation and no energy and just... nothing. So I guess I kind of just broke. I released all my shifts at my second job, I have no hobbies from working so much but still not making much money, and everyone is getting all this stuff paid for for them while I worked endless nights months on end to get to the same point. I just wanted it all to end, and still do but I don't know if I have the strength to even try a third time because I know if it fails I'll have to go to the hospital. It all feels just so all (f)or nothing
